source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Ornella,

Thanks so much for coming back to me!

At this stage we are leaning toward digital printing, mainly for pareos and textile accessories. The overall direction is refined, artisanal and luxury resort focused - natural textures, woven references and imperfect details rather than anything too polished or overly graphic.

Ive attached the reference imagery so you can get a better sense of the diagonal basket weave direction and overall feel. We definitely want it to feel elevated and organic rather than flat and have that textural element.

We are hoping we can enlarge these (or use them as references) to create our own textile print. IS this possible? We also want to create 2 x block colour pareos using the mustard / burgandy colours in that reference attached too with the black border. But keen to get your help first on the Zebra & woven print.

Completely understand on timing too — quality is the priority for us so we’d rather allow the right amount of time to get the final files feeling considered and production ready.

Let me know what you think

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I am so happy I found you!!
This sounds great and exactly aligned with the direction we’re after. Love the idea of building the texture manually so it still feels organic and elevated rather than overly digital.

Let’s move ahead with the zebra and basket weave first, then we can roll into the block colour pareos once approved. I can also confirm the Pantone colours for you too! But you might be able to get them from that image.

The fabric will most likely be cotton voile, potentially silk/cotton voile depending on final sampling, so I’ll confirm exact fabrication with the supplier shortly.

Looking forward to seeing the first check-in!!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Orne,

Perfect, this all sounds great!
Completely understand on the Pantones + happy for you to start building the visual approximation first and then we can refine once final Pantones are confirmed with production. That makes total sense.

For the basket weave scale, we are envisioning the diamonds sitting at roughly 5cm diagonally across the repeat. We’d also love a very very fine mustard edge outlining the weave detail.

For the zebra print, we’d like this one to feature a black edge/border around the design.
I’ve also attached a PDF with the mockups and additional references for you to work from!

I know you have quoted on the two patterns for now, so we can begin with those and then review the additional designs afterwards. But can I confirm if the other two block versions are included in this quote? I’ve included the Pantone colours for the terracotta and mustard tones we were hoping to work with, so let me know if that’s possible from your side.

I’ll also check with the supplier regarding the ICC colour profile and send through if they have one available!! Will jump onto Upwork and activate the contract shortly so we can get things moving officially.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Phoebe!
Attached you'll find the Milestone 1 PDF with all the prints developed so far. Here's a summary of what's included and what I need from you to move forward!
1\. What's included in this delivery
Basket Weave print in two texture versions, Frottage and Reference-Based, each with two scales. Zebra print in three directional options, Noir, Savanna and Gold Skin, each shown at tile detail and full repeat scale. Two block colour pareos, Rooibos Tea and Sudan Brown, each with two border scale options, Slim and Full. All mockups are shown at 110 x 180 cm as reference.
Full resolution repeat files are available here for your review: <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DOsO-ZQ_6MK-nSQKCBqWlUPanCcAsk0F?usp=drive_link>
2\. Your choices, what I need from you
Which Zebra direction do you prefer, 01 Noir, 02 Savanna or 03 Gold Skin? Which Basket Weave texture do you prefer, Frottage or Reference-Based? For the block colour pareos, which border scale works better for your collection, Slim or Full? Please use the measurements shown in the PDF as reference when evaluating each option, they reflect real scale on fabric.
3\. A note on colour, screen vs fabric
The warm golden tones, especially in the Gold Skin zebra variant, will appear slightly more matte on fabric than on screen. This is normal for pigment printing on voile and is not a loss of quality, it's just how the material reads the colour. I wanted you to know this before production so there are no surprises!
4\. What I need to move forward with final files
Confirmation of your fabric supplier's ICC profile for CMYK calibration. Confirmation of exact Pantone references with your supplier if available. Final seam allowance measurements you need added to the digital files before production. Any additional modifications or notes on the selected prints.
5\. Timeline for Milestone 2
Once I have your feedback and selections, I'll work toward May 29 as the Milestone 2 deadline. If I finish earlier, I'll send everything before that date!
Looking forward to hearing your thoughts!
Orne

The folder contains the four production-ready pareo files, the tile files for the Zebra Savanna and Diagonal Basket Weave, and the Technical Sheet with all colour references and file specifications. There's also a README with a full description of the folder contents.
